text: now i can not see parts of it that are not painted. just fyi. so an unpainted face is just invisible now
resolution: Unpainted faces were invisible because the base-coat effect was keyed on [painting] and early-returned while tex was still null on first paint entry, so it never re-ran and the RGBA paint texture was never opaque-filled. Re-keyed on [painting, sceneName, !!tex] and made it RESTORE saved paint (else base-coat). Added persistence: stroke-end reads the texture back and stores it as raw RGBA base64 in localstore keyed by model, restored on entry — survives hot reload AND full restart, with no @reactjit/image dependency so it stays pure cart hot-reload (no host rebuild). This is what stops hot reload from wiping the paint.
